item.title: WVU Esports Team speaks to local middle schoolers about careers in gaming industry
item.description: MORGANTOWN, W.Va. (WBOY) — According to the Entertainment Software Association, nearly two-thirds of Americans regularly play video games, and on Monday morning, students at South Middle School in Morgantown had the chance to learn more about how they could put that experience to use as a career. item.title: West Virginia drivers encouraged to check vehicles for recalls during Vehicle Safety Recalls Week
item.description: March 2-8 is Vehicle Safety Recalls Week, an effort by both the National Highway Safety Administration (NHTSA) and the West Virginia Governor's Highway Safety program (GHSP) to encourage drivers to check on the state of their personal vehicles.

item.description: The road is currently closed and "will be closed for several hours" The Facebook Post states. Traffic is being detoured via Old Tunnelton Pike and Snyder Loop Road at this time. They are asking people to avoid the area if possible.

item.title: Woman charged after 2 juveniles call Ritchie County 911 because she 'would not wake up'
item.description: A woman has been charged after two juveniles called the Ritchie County 911 Center to say she would not wake up.

item.title: Federal judge threatens legal action over illegal ICE detentions in West Virginia
item.description: A federal judge in West Virginia has threatened government officials with legal consequences, including contempt, if continued violations of the Fifth Amendment continue by Immigration & Customs Enforcement (ICE).

item.title: 3 charged after deputies find juveniles living in Lewis County home with drug use, rotting food
item.description: Three people have been charged after deputies said they found juveniles living in a Lewis County home with drug use and rotting food.

item.title: Marion County Board of Education talks Superintendent contract, potential consolidation
item.description: The future of Marion County's Superintendent position has been in question during the last few weeks, sparking a discussion about the topic at Monday's Board of Education meeting.

item.title: 2 charged after infant allegedly found malnourished in Glenville
item.description: Two people are in custody and are facing charges in Glenville after an infant in their care was allegedly found malnourished.

item.title: Man claiming to be CPS worker charged for DUI while transporting minor in Barbour County
